start.title: Welcome to Artic
start.lead: Artic is a web tool for labelling, visualising and correcting speech recordings and the signals derived from them. It works standalone in the browser and together with a server.
start.openFilesText: Drop audio or video files here, optionally with matching TextGrid or annotJSON files.
start.dropHint: Drop your files to open them
start.demoText: Try Artic with one of the small example databases.
start.connectText: Work against a database over the EMU protocol on WebSocket.

footer.cta: Do you use our platforms, datasets or analyses in your work? We would like to hear from you!

about.title: About
about.credits: Artic is a fork of the EMU-webApp (IPS-LMU), maintained by Humlab.

settings.heatMap: Draw spectrogram in heat map colours
settings.title: Settings
settings.hierarchyIntro: Choose which levels and labels the hierarchy view shows.
settings.hintPathCanvas: Draws the selected path as a strip above the levels.
settings.hintPath: The chain of levels the hierarchy view and path strip follow.
settings.hintAttrDefs: Which label (attribute) to display for each level in the path.
settings.hintFontScaling: Scales label text in the annotation levels. 100% is default.
settings.hintChannel: Which audio channel is drawn. File has {n}; channels count from 0.
settings.specIntro: Audio sample rate {sr} Hz, so the highest frequency that can be shown is {ny} Hz.
settings.specIntroNone: No audio loaded. Frequency limits are checked once a file is open.
settings.hintRange: Whole numbers, 0 up to {ny} Hz. Default 0–5000.
settings.hintWindowSize: Short window (about 0.005 s) shows formants as wide bands; long window (about 0.03 s) shows harmonics. Default 0.01.
settings.hintDynamic: Level range shown below the loudest point. Lower values give more contrast. Default 70.
settings.hintPreEmph: Boosts high frequencies before analysis. 0 turns it off. Default 0.97.
settings.hintWindowFn: Shape of the analysis window. GAUSS gives smooth, low-leakage spectrograms.
settings.hintInvert: Swap light and dark in the spectrogram.
settings.hintHeatMap: Colour the spectrogram with the three anchors below instead of grey.
settings.hintAnchors: Colours for low, middle and high energy. Values 0–255.
